terminal_decision: Reject both normalized turn-record architectures for transfer or integration.

measurement_corrections: sentence and complete-turn source IDs match by same-speaker same-turn text containment
fan-in bytes measure the compact synthesis payload rather than the full custody ledger

finding: A single artifact cannot yet satisfy both broad audit capture and compact reasoning fan-in. Compression that meets the budget loses reviewed minority signals; high-recall capture saturates the budget. The three-lens consolidator also adds operational fragility.

founder_decision.question: Should Lolla explicitly split broad conversation audit capture from the compact reasoning handoff, or continue requiring one artifact to serve both purposes?
founder_decision.recommended_option: Split them: keep an append-only broad audit ledger for accountability, and derive a separately evaluated compact reasoning handoff through probabilistic selection with full lineage back to the ledger.
founder_decision.why_material: This changes the product contract and evaluation target, not merely the implementation.
